package.description: Mesen-S is a cross-platform (Windows & Linux) SNES emulator built in C++ and C#.

en-US.description: Mesen-S is a cross-platform (Windows & Linux) SNES emulator built in C++ and C#.
en-US.longDescription: Mesen-S is a high-accuracy SNES emulator for Windows and Linux. Game Boy and Game Boy Color games are also supported, along with Super Game Boy emulation. It contains most of the features found in Mesen, including an extensive set of debugging tools.
en-US.name: Mesen-S
